description: Show or hide the mold report for the active part, in the part local frame. on true measures volume, projected area along the pull, and the side-action count, then returns part mass, press tonnage, tooling, and part price for grade and quantity. Mass is volume times the published resin density. Tooling is the published rate card: a base mold cost scaled by projected area, plus a per-side-action adder. Part price is material cost plus press time at the card machine rate plus tooling divided by quantity. assumptions lists the rates, sources, as-of dates, and formulas. A grade with no density or price, or a part with no wall or projected area, is flagged and not guessed. A priced catalog, when one is passed in, still prices from that catalog. The same function fills the pane and the spreadsheet. The resin default is PC/ABS. Press tonnage is the required tonnage of the measured projected area. The report says Mold report and Budgetary, not binding. It does not paint a skin. Opening it clears the other molding tools. on false closes the panel. Omit on to toggle. Read-only. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

grade.description: Resin grade from the public library. Omit to keep the current grade. The default is PC/ABS.

on.description: true shows the mold report. false closes it. Omit to toggle.

quantity.description: Parts to price. Omit to keep the current quantity. The default is 1000.
